---
title: "decontX_ambient_RNA.Rmd"
output: Calculate ambient RNA contamination using decontX
author: Haewon Shin
---

```{r}
# BiocManager::install("decontX")
library(decontX)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```

```{r}
Idents(icell) <- "sample"
sample_names <- levels(Idents(icell))

for (sample in sample_names) {
  obj <- subset(icell, idents = sample)
  counts <- GetAssayData(object = obj, slot = "counts")
  sce <- SingleCellExperiment(list(counts = counts))
  sce <- decontX(sce)
  dens <- density(colData(sce)$decontX_contamination)
  print(sample)
  print(dens$x[which.max(dens$y)])
}

```
